description: Resume a paused Batch run: it picks up its remaining tasks again, billed as they finish. Idempotent on a run that is not paused; a run that already ended answers with its final status and already_ended:true. Needs credits: BATCH_INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS or BATCH_KEY_CAP_REACHED otherwise.

job_id.description: Batch job id returned by batch_create or batch_list

name: batch_resume
